free_tier.stated: Free plans receive 2,000 Harness Cloud credits every month, and unused credits expire at month end; Linux xsmall (2 cores, 7 GB) costs 1 credit a minute and Linux small (4 cores, 15 GB) 2 credits a minute
free_tier.notes: the pricing page's Free plan lists Harness Open Source, Litmus Chaos and community support and names no CI module or Harness Cloud allowance; the Harness Cloud product page and the CI documentation state the 2,000 a month

per_object_cap.stated: on the Free plan a stage times out at 1 hour and a pipeline at 2 hours; each CI stage runs in a new ephemeral VM

retention.stated: unverified: no log or artifact retention period for the Free plan was found in the pages read; cache above the 2 GB Free limit evicts the oldest caches

egress.terms: network transfer from Harness Cloud to customer-managed storage is limited to 1 GB on Free, 5 GB on Startup and 10 GB on Enterprise
egress.free_allowance: 1 GB of network transfer to customer-managed storage

interface_detail: a Harness pipeline built in the visual editor or YAML, with a CI stage on Harness Cloud infrastructure and a Git connector to the repository
tooling: Harness-managed VMs: Linux AMD64 and ARM64 from 2 to 96 cores, Windows, and macOS on Apple M4; Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 images with preinstalled tools; steps run on the VM or in a Docker container. The local runner, which the user installs and runs on a machine of their own, rented or free, has no build limit and needs no card; it comes after the hosted offer
chaining: 2,000 Linux xsmall minutes a month behind a card check and a business email domain; the 1 GB transfer limit to outside storage makes it a place to run work rather than to ship large outputs

limits.value: 2,000 credits a month on Free, unused credits expire; Linux xsmall (2 cores, 7 GB) 1 credit a minute, Linux small (4 cores, 15 GB) 2 credits a minute
2 concurrent pipeline executions per account on the Free plan, not editable; 2 concurrent steps or stages within one execution
Harness Cloud concurrent stages on Free: Linux 20, Windows 1, macOS 1
stage timeout 1 hour and pipeline timeout 2 hours on the Free plan
1 GB of network transfer from Harness Cloud to customer-managed storage on Free

limits_note: 2 GB of CI Intelligence cache storage on Free, with the oldest caches evicted beyond it; use beyond the credits continues and is invoiced in arrears
binding_note: identity binds before any limit: Harness Cloud on Free needs card validation and a business email domain. Among the limits, the 2,000 monthly credits are 2,000 xsmall minutes, about 33 hours (2,000 / 60); the 1-hour stage timeout binds first for any single long job

identity_cost.detail: Harness Cloud on the Free plan is limited to business email domains, with Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo and other unverified domains blocked, and Free plans require credit card validation to use it; the Harness Cloud product page says 'No credit card required', which the CI documentation contradicts

reliability_note: credits used beyond the allowance are invoiced in arrears, and Harness may suspend Harness Cloud executions when they are not paid
confidence_note: the CI subscription, Harness Cloud and pipeline settings documentation, the pricing page and the Harness Cloud product page were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; the sign-up gate itself is a single-page app and was not passed. Raised by a sign-up outcome with a generic and a custom-domain address.

notes: The allowance is real on paper, 2,000 credits a month with 20 concurrent Linux stages, but the account-wide limit of 2 concurrent pipeline executions and the 1-hour stage timeout make it small, and the gate in front of it is a business email domain plus card validation. The pricing page no longer lists CI under Free, so whether a new Free account still receives Harness Cloud credits is unverified without a sign-up.
